He leaves the building shortly after the arrival of the {{player}}. He later appears with all the other sages at [[N's Castle]], blocking the player's way to [[N]]. However, he is stopped by the arrival of the [[Unova]] [[Gym Leader]]s as they clear a path for the player. After Ghetsis has been defeated, Rood can be found on {{rt|18|Unova}}, where he gives the player {{TM|32|Double Team}} and is arrested by [[Looker]]. In {{B2W2}}, Rood is encountered living with [[Anthea and Concordia|Anthea, Concordia]] and several Grunts in the original Team Plasma's safehouse in [[Driftveil City]]. After losing in a battle with the player, he gives the player [[N's Zorua]]. Shortly afterwards, he appears on {{rt|6|Unova}} after the player has encountered {{p|Cobalion}}. {{color2|fff|Generation V}} |} ==In animation== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Rood PG.png|thumb|250px|Rood in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] ===Pokémon Generations=== Rood appeared in ''[[PG13|The Uprising]]''. He was shown at [[N's Castle]] as it was rising from the ground and surrounding the {{un|Pokémon League}}. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{red color}}|bordercolor={{red color light}} |ja=伊原正明 ''Masaaki Ihara'' |en= |pt_br=Cláudio Galvan |es_eu=Joaquín Gómez}} {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Rood Gorm Bronius Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Rood in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== Rood is one of the Seven Sages of Team Plasma. Three years prior to the start of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}, he was tasked with finding information on the Mythical Pokémon {{p|Victini}} so that its power may be used to bring victory for Team Plasma. Rood debuted in person in ''[[PS467|Letting Go]]'', where he and the other sages were seen in [[Accumula Town]] after [[Ghetsis]] gave a speech convincing people to release their Pokémon. Although not seen in person, in ''[[PS480|At Liberty on Liberty Garden]]'', Rood sent three of his subordinate {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s to [[Liberty Garden]] so they could capture Victini. The Grunts were eventually defeated by {{adv|Black}}, who used Victini's ability to bring victory to help him defeat the Grunts' Pokémon. In ''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]'', Team Plasma launched their attack on the {{un|Pokémon League}}, surrounding the building with N's Castle. As a form of mockery and display of Team Plasma's power, the [[Gym Leader]]s were hoisted on cross-like fixtures and displayed in front of the masses. While Black went ahead to face {{adv|N}}, a group of regular Trainers led by {{tc|Hiker}} Andy fought the sages in his place. Together, Andy and the others managed to free the Gym Leaders, forcing Rood and the other sages to flee. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== Two years later, Rood and the other sages were sought after by the [[International Police]] members {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Looker}}, who aimed to arrest them along with the other remaining Team Plasma members. Unlike the other sages, Rood, along with Gorm, decided to side with the members of Team Plasma who believed in N's ideals. In ''[[PS539|Frozen World]]'', Rood arrived in [[Castelia City]] shortly after it was frozen by the [[Plasma Frigate]]. There, he met {{adv|Whitley}}, a former Team Plasma Grunt tasked with guarding a memory card containing data on a device that could counteract the Pokémon-controlling [[Colress Machine]]. Whitley revealed she lost the memory card, but it was found by [[Hugh]], a classmate of hers. Rood had his subordinates search the unconscious Hugh's body, only to discover it wasn't on his person. Whitley came to conclusion he must have left it behind at the [[Aspertia City]]'s [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]]. Rood decided to leave immediately, but Whitley feared leaving her classmates behind would expose her identity as a member of Team Plasma. Rood had N's {{TP|N|Zorua}} {{a|Illusion|take}} Whitley's form to fool the classmates long enough for them to find the memory card. Before they could act, Whitley pushed Rood out of the way of an incoming {{p|Mandibuzz}}, leading to her being captured and taken aboard the Plasma Frigate, allowing Rood to escape. In ''[[PS543|Abyssal Ruins]]'', Hugh awakened at the Aspertia Trainers' School. Rood requested Hugh reveal the location of the memory card, but the boy refused as Team Plasma stole his [[Hugh's sister|younger sister]]'s {{p|Purrloin}} years ago. Rood assured Hugh that Purrloin was safe in the care of someone else and promised to retrieve it once the memory card was dealt with. Before Hugh could respond, a group of Plasma Grunts broke into the room in order to stop them. Hugh reluctantly gave up the key to his room and told Rood to get the memory card while he stayed behind and kept the Grunts busy. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', after the memory card was retrieved, Rood and Hugh fled to the white Team Plasma's hideout and activated the anti-Colress Machine device. Afterward, Rood went to the [[Giant Chasm]], where he confronted Colress, telling him that his plans had been foiled. The device successfully freed {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} from Colress's control, only for it to absorb {{p|Reshiram}} and transform into {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}. In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', after Team Plasma's defeat, Rood was arrested and taken into custody by the [[International Police]]. He was visited by Whitley, who returned to her normal life after her friends agreed to keep her status as a former Team Plasma member a secret. Rood informed Whitley that N would be released on bail so he could work to return the Pokémon liberated by Team Plasma back to their original owners. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rood |pkmn=Chandelure |stage1=Lampent |gender=male |type1=Ghost |type2=Fire |img=Rood Lampent Adventures.png |img2=Rood Chandelure Adventures.png |epnum=PS521 |epname=Triple Threat |desc={{p|Chandelure}} is Rood's first known Pokémon. He was first seen as a {{p|Lampent}} and was used at the {{un|Pokémon League}} to combat the Trainers helping Black rescue the kidnapped Gym Leaders. When the Gym Leaders were freed, Lampent was left to fight alone with the other sages' Pokémon after the Seven Sages escaped. Prior to ''[[PS543|Abyssal Ruins]]'', he evolved into a Chandelure. Chandelure's known moves are {{m|Hex}} and {{m|Inferno}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rood |pkmn=Swoobat |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Rood Swoobat Adventures.png |epnum=PS546 |epname=Giant Chasm |desc={{p|Swoobat}} is Rood's second known Pokémon. In ''[[PS539|Frozen World]]'', Zorua appeared with Rood to take {{adv|Whitley}}'s appearance with his {{a|Illusion}} Ability, allowing her to leave her classmates' side to search for the memory card contained in her pendant.}} ==Trivia== * Rood is the only sage that gives a [[TM]] that raises the user's stats by a total of one stage.
